job.title: Commissioning Technician
job.description:
About the Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Commissioning Technician with a strong electrical and/or mechanical background to support the commissioning and delivery of power generation projects.
Working alongside project managers, engineers, customers and technical teams, you will play an important role in ensuring equipment and installations meet manufacturer specifications, project requirements and customer expectations.
This is an opportunity to apply your practical technical experience across diesel and gas engine power systems, generators and associated equipment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and undertake commissioning activities for supplied and installed plant.
  • Ensure equipment and installations meet manufacturer specifications and customer requirements.
  • Conduct commissioning checks, testing and performance assessments.
  • Work with diesel and gas engine power generation systems.
  • Commission generators, generator controls and associated equipment.
  • Coordinate and manage subcontractors from a technical and commercial perspective where required.
  • Liaise with project managers, project engineers and customers on commissioning activities.
  • Prepare commissioning reports and maintain technical, quality and safety records.
  • Participate in project planning meetings and design reviews.
  • Maintain a strong focus on safety, quality and continuous improvement.

About You
We are interested in hearing from technicians who bring practical industry experience and a genuine passion for electrical and mechanical systems.
Ideally, you will have:

  • A recognised Electrical trade qualification, together with a Mechanical trade qualification or relevant mechanical experience.
  • Experience working with diesel and gas engine power systems.
  • Knowledge of generators and generator control systems.
  • Experience in electrical and/or mechanical commissioning.
  • Experience operating and maintaining diesel or gas generators.
  • Understanding of Australian electrical standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and AS/NZS 3010, or equivalent international standards.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with customers, project teams and stakeholders.
  • A commitment to safety, quality and delivering excellent outcomes.

Post-trade qualifications or diplomas in electrical or mechanical disciplines will be highly regarded.

Why Balpara?

  • Be part of a growing Australian engineering and technical services business.
  • Work alongside experienced industry professionals.
  • Gain exposure to specialist power generation and electrical infrastructure projects.
  • Develop your technical capabilities and broaden your industry experience.
  • Explore long-term career opportunities in Australia.

Apply now!
If you are ready to embrace a new challenge in your career , apply now!
Please be advised that final stage applicants will be required to complete Assessments, Testing and a National Criminal Check.

To submit your application in strict confidence, click the 'apply' button. If you require further information, please contact Marlien Kohle on mkohle@balpara.com.au

To learn more about us or to view all Balpara job opportunities visit www.balpara.com.au

job.title: Primary Substation Designer / Drafter
job.description:
Big Projects. Bigger Opportunities.


Ready to take your career to the next level?
Join Balpara and work on major high-voltage and extra-high-voltage (EHV) substation projects for leading electricity utilities across Australia.

This is an opportunity to expand your technical expertise, build an impressive portfolio of substation projects and work alongside experienced engineers and designers delivering critical electricity infrastructure.

If you enjoy technical challenges, producing high-quality designs and seeing your work contribute to real-world projects, we’d love to hear from you.

Why join Balpara?

  • Work on Major EHV Substation Projects
  • Take Your Skills Further
  • Variety That Keeps You Engaged
  • Work-Life Balance That Matters

About the role
As a Primary Substation Design Drafter, you’ll support the development of detailed engineering drawings and design documentation for high-voltage and EHV substations.
Working closely with engineers and project teams, you’ll help translate engineering concepts into accurate, practical and constructible design solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing and updating primary substation design drawings and documentation.
  • Developing substation general arrangements, equipment layouts and sections.
  • Producing drawings for primary plant, busbar arrangements, structures and associated equipment.
  • Applying electrical clearances, spatial requirements and relevant design standards.
  • Coordinating drawings with civil, structural and secondary design disciplines.
  • Considering constructability, maintainability and Safety in Design throughout the drafting process.
  • Incorporating engineering mark-ups, design changes and project requirements.
  • Supporting design reviews and ensuring drawings meet project and client standards.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in electrical drafting or design, ideally within substations or high-voltage infrastructure.
  • Experience with AutoCAD and the preparation of detailed technical drawings.
  • An understanding of primary substation equipment, layouts and electrical clearances, or a willingness to develop this knowledge.
  • The ability to interpret engineering mark-ups, specifications and technical requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality drawings.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with engineers and other design disciplines.
  • A practical understanding of constructability and design coordination.
  • Experience with EHV substations and utility projects will be highly regarded.

Join Balpara
Build your career in a specialised area of the power industry, contribute to major substation projects and develop the technical skills to take your drafting career further.
For a confidential discussion, contact Mariam Wissa on 0400 979 271.


Apply now to join Balpara and be part of our continued growth.

Final-stage applicants will be required to complete assessments, testing and a National Criminal Check.
Learn more at www.balpara.com.au.

job.title: Electrical Engineer / Technical Officer
job.description:
Big Projects. Real Impact. Your Next Career Move.
Are you an Electrical Engineer or experienced Technical Officer in power distribution design, ready to take the next step in your career?
At Balpara, you’ll have the opportunity to work on major electricity network projects across Victoria, broaden your technical expertise and take greater ownership of projects from design through to delivery.
We work with some of the leading electricity utilities in Victoria, giving you exposure to diverse projects, real engineering challenges and the opportunity to build a strong portfolio of work.

Why join Balpara?
Deliver practical engineering solutions for leading electricity utilities, including CitiPower/Powercor, United Energy, AusNet and Jemena.

  • Take Your Career to the Next Level
  • Build Your Project Portfolio
  • See Your Designs Come to Life
  • Grow Your Technical Expertise
  • Make a Real Impact
  • Great Projects. Supportive Team. Better Balance

About the role

  • Delivering electrical distribution designs across overhead, underground and/or distribution substation projects.
  • Taking ownership of projects of varying complexity and coordinating design deliverables to meet quality, programme and budget requirements.
  • Applying engineering principles, industry standards and utility requirements to develop compliant design solutions.
  • Considering Safety in Design, constructability, maintainability and interactions with existing network assets.
  • Attending project sites and providing technical advice and support when required.
  • Collaborating with clients, network representatives, engineers, designers, project managers and other stakeholders.
  • Resolving technical challenges and identifying opportunities to improve design quality and project delivery.

What you need to have:

  • Proven experience and understanding in electrical distribution design
  • The ability to consider safety, constructability and other existing assets when developing designs
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach
  • Knowledge and application of Safety in Design
  • Experience with AutoCAD
  • Experience with NEARA would be advantageous, but is not essential

Join Balpara

For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Mariam Wissa on 0400 979 271 .

Apply now to join Balpara and be part of our continued growth.

job.title: Project Manager / Delivery Lead
job.description:
Take your career to the next level with Balpara!

We’re seeking an experienced Project Manager / Delivery Lead to join our growing Electrical Distribution Network team.
This is a high-impact role suited to a professional who thrives on ownership, stakeholder engagement, and delivering complex customer-driven projects. You’ll play a key role in delivering Customer Initiated Augmentation Works (CIAW) and similar projects, ensuring outcomes meet both customer expectations and regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, ensuring successful delivery of projects in line with business and regulatory requirements
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of customer-initiated projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to quality and HS&E standards
  • Negotiate project outcomes with customers, balancing commercial, technical, and network capacity requirements
  • Manage internal and external stakeholders, including councils, service providers, and contractors
  • Identify, communicate, and proactively manage project risks, ensuring minimal impact to delivery timelines and costs
  • Prepare project scoping, concept, and detailed design documentation, ensuring compliance with internal processes and QA standards
  • Review subdivision plans and provide clear, practical technical advice
  • Act as a key technical point of contact for both internal teams and external stakeholder

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience within the Electrical distribution / Power utilities sector
  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in project management or project delivery
  • Strong understanding of network, regulatory, and customer-driven project requirements
  • Experience managing stakeholders across customers, contractors, and authorities
  • Diploma of Project Management or tertiary qualifications in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent) are highly advantageous.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to manage risk, drive outcomes, and deliver under pressure

Why Join Balpara?
Balpara partners with utilities, engineering consultancies, electrical contractors, developers, councils, and transport bodies to deliver high-quality, sustainable outcomes across Australia.
We’re driven by our values of Passion, Teamwork, Integrity, Excellence and Respect, and we genuinely invest in our people. If you’re ready to take ownership of impactful projects, and grow with a company that values innovation and collaboration, this could be the perfect role for you.

Please be advised that final stage applicants will be required to complete Assessments, Testing and a National Criminal Check.

To submit your application in strict confidence, please click the “Apply” button. For further information, feel free to contact Marlien Kohle on 0415 804 882 or via email at mkohle@balpara.com.au.

To view all Balpara job opportunities visit www.balpara.com.au

job.title: Secondary Drafter – Protection & Control
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Secondary Drafter to join our electrical engineering team, supporting the design and delivery of protection, control, metering and SCADA systems across HV and EHV substation projects.

This is an opportunity to work across both greenfield and brownfield projects, collaborating closely with engineers and project teams to deliver high-quality secondary system designs for electrical utility assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate drafting requirements across small, medium and large projects from inception through to completion.
  • Produce basic and detailed electrical schematics for protection and control panels in MV and HV substations.
  • Develop AC/DC schematics, control circuits, wiring diagrams and termination drawings.
  • Prepare cable schedules, terminal arrangements and wiring documentation.
  • Support the design and development of protection, control, metering and SCADA systems.
  • Work closely with engineers on protection relays, trip and close circuits and control schemes.
  • Interpret how primary substation equipment interfaces with secondary protection and control systems.
  • Assist with the design, development and optimisation of existing and future electrical assets.
  • Ensure drafting deliverables meet project requirements, quality standards, timelines and budgets.

About You

  • You will have experience in secondary systems design within HV/EHV environments, ideally with exposure to electrical utility projects and substations.
  • We are particularly interested in candidates with:
  • Experience with substation secondary systems.
  • Strong understanding of protection and control concepts.
  • Experience producing and interpreting electrical schematics.
  • Experience with AC/DC schematics and control circuits.
  • Understanding of protection relays, trip and close circuits.
  • Experience with protection and control panels and terminal arrangements.
  • Ability to produce cable schedules, wiring diagrams and termination drawings.
  • Understanding of the interface between primary equipment and protection/control systems.
  • Experience with greenfield and/or brownfield substation projects.
  • Familiarity with protection relay configuration and fault analysis software
  • Experience within the Australian electricity industry, including interstate projects is preferred.
  • Experience working with clients and stakeholders is desirable.
  • High proficiency in AutoCAD and MicroStation

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is detail-oriented, technically capable and collaborative, with the ability to deliver time-critical work in a fast-paced environment.
You’ll be comfortable working closely with engineers, solving problems, managing competing priorities and contributing innovative solutions to complex electrical design challenges.

Why you’ll love working with us

Since 1976, Balpara has built a reputation for excellence in engineering, design, project management, and surveying. Our team supports clients across power utilities, civil and electrical consultancies, contractors, developers, councils, and transport authorities.

If you have strong secondary drafting experience and want to work on a diverse range of HV, EHV and utility substation projects, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now!

Please be advised that final stage applicants will be required to complete Assessments, Testing and a National Criminal Check.

To submit your application in strict confidence, click the 'apply' button. If you require further information, please contact Mariam Wissa on 0400 979 271.

To learn more about us or to view all Balpara job opportunities visit www.balpara.com.au
